1:
SELECT * 
FROM eventspaces 
WHERE (event_space LIKE '%Banquet Hall%' OR event_space LIKE '%Conference Room%') 
  AND capacity >= 200;
2:
SELECT *
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE ("event_space" ILIKE 'Banquet Hall' OR "event_space" ILIKE 'Conference Room')
  AND "capacity" = 200;
3:
SELECT "restaurants"."name", 'Restaurant' AS "type"
FROM "restaurants"
WHERE "restaurants"."cuisine" ILIKE 'Italian' AND "restaurants"."food_service" ILIKE 'Restaurant'
UNION ALL
SELECT "restaurants"."name", 'Café' AS "type"
FROM "restaurants"
WHERE "restaurants"."cuisine" ILIKE 'Italian' AND "restaurants"."food_service" ILIKE 'Café';
6:
SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE (s."role" ILIKE '%chef%') OR (s."role" ILIKE '%server%' AND s."language" ILIKE '%english%')
ORDER BY s."role", s."name";
8:
SELECT s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE s."role" IN ('Chef', 'Server')
  AND s."language" = 'English';
108:
SELECT mr."salary"
FROM "medicalroles" mr
JOIN "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr ON mr."roleid" = hmr."roleid"
GROUP BY mr."roleid", mr."salary"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hospitals");
109:
SELECT 
    s."name" AS specialist_name,
    sys."system_name" AS system_name
FROM 
    "it_support_specialists" s
    INNER JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" ss ON s."id" = ss."it_specialist_id"
    INNER JOIN "systems" sys ON ss."system_id" = sys."system_id"
ORDER BY 
    s."name", sys."system_name";
110:
SELECT 
    s."name" AS specialist_name,
    sys."system_name",
    sys."is_active"
FROM "it_support_specialists" s
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" ss ON s."id" = ss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" sys ON ss."system_id" = sys."system_id"
ORDER BY s."name", sys."system_name";
111:
SELECT 
    iss."name" AS "specialist_name",
    sys."system_name",
    sys."is_active"
FROM "it_support_specialists" iss
LEFT JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss_sys 
    ON iss."id" = iss_sys."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN "systems" sys 
    ON iss_sys."system_id" = sys."system_id"
ORDER BY iss."name", sys."system_name";
112:
SELECT "r"."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" "r"
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" "ir" ON "r"."id" = "ir"."responsibilityid"
GROUP BY "r"."id", "r"."responsibility"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "ir"."internshipid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "internships");
113:
SELECT 
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM "internships" i
INNER JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
INNER JOIN "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY i."title", r."responsibility";

115:
SELECT
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM "internships" i
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"

261: SELECT "minimum_years", "preferred_years" FROM "jobs" ORDER BY "salary" DESC LIMIT 1;
262:
SELECT "p"."title", "sd"."salary_range", "sd"."hourly_rate"
FROM "position" "p"
JOIN "salarydetails" "sd" ON "p"."id" = "sd"."positionid"
WHERE "p"."title" ILIKE '%software developer%';
263:
SELECT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE p."title" LIKE '%software developer%';
265: SELECT "preferred_years" FROM "jobs" ORDER BY "salary" DESC LIMIT 1;
266:
SELECT 
    "minimum_years",
    "preferred_years"
FROM "jobs"
ORDER BY "salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
